summary: Fresh FOC Heat research for the Sep. 14, 2026 FOC window. One current BUY is justified: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero/Tomb Raider #1 Cover A at $4.99 or less, limited to one copy. The key evidence is the strong aftermarket response to Lara Croft's first appearance in G.I. Joe #330, including distributor sellout and repeated completed sales for the 1:10 Lara Croft variant. The crossover #1 itself has no completed sales yet and carries a large variant program, so conviction remains moderate rather than high.
orderingWindow: FOC is Monday, Sep. 14, 2026. Current PRH/Comic Previews listings show Sep. 14 FOC. M&M Comics states weekly FOC orders are due 7pm Central every Monday, equivalent to 8pm Eastern in Indiana; retailer-specific deadlines can be earlier.

verifiedFacts: Lara Croft first appeared in G.I. JOE: A Real American Hero #330, preceding this crossover #1.
#1 has 1:25, 1:50 and 1:100 incentives plus other variants.
marketEvidence: #330 sold out at distributor level and was rushed back to print.
#330 1:10 Lara Croft variant has repeated completed sales generally around $20-$45.
MyComicShop lists #330 second-print Lara Croft copies around $16-$25.
buy.thesis: The preceding issue provides the strongest current demand signal, but #1 itself has no completed sales and carries high variant/supply risk. Buy one standard Cover A at $4.99 or less; do not chase ratios.
